target.title: fix(codex): guard parseRequest JSON.parse against malformed WebSocket data
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

`extensions/codex/src/app-server/sandbox-exec-server/json-rpc.ts:30` calls bare `JSON.parse(text)` in `parseRequest()` when parsing WebSocket raw data into JSON-RPC request objects. Malformed data from a sandbox exec server WebSocket connection → raw `SyntaxError` instead of descriptive validation error.

## Changes

- `json-rpc.ts`: wrap `JSON.parse(text)` in try/catch, throw `Error("JSON-RPC request body is not valid JSON.")` instead of raw SyntaxError
- `test/_proof_codex_sandbox_json_rpc_guard.mts`: standalone proof script (7/7 PASS)

Label: bugfix | merge-risk: 🟢 minimal | AI-assisted

## Evidence

```
$ node --import tsx test/_proof_codex_sandbox_json_rpc_guard.mts

[1] malformed JSON Buffer → descriptive Error
  PASS  throws Error (not SyntaxError)
  PASS  message includes "not valid JSON"

[2] valid JSON-RPC request → returns correctly
  PASS  no error thrown
  PASS  returns object
  PASS  method is "tools/call"

[3] empty Buffer → throws Error
  PASS  throws Error for empty data

[4] valid JSON non-object → requireObject validation
  PASS  throws Error for non-object JSON

==================================================
  Passed: 7  Failed: 0  Total: 7
==================================================
```

Before: `parseRequest(Buffer.from("NOT JSON"))` → raw SyntaxError
After: `parseRequest(Buffer.from("NOT JSON"))` → `Error: JSON-RPC request body is not valid JSON.`
